brief:
Israel's occupation authorities are advancing plans to build 3,401 settlement units in the E1 zone east of Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The scheme aims to expand "Greater Jerusalem" and sever the city's geographic ties to surrounding Palestinian areas while cutting off territorial continuity between northern and southern West Bank regions.

The settlement expansion coincides with broader Israeli construction efforts and the displacement of Bedouin communities in the area.

title: Israel plans 3,401 settlement units east of Jerusalem
